shortDescription: Indian IT services firm Hexaware NSE:HEXT said on Wednesday that Vivek Jetley, a senior executive at EXL, would take over as CEO, effective October 28.The company also said that Srikrishna Ramakarthikeyan had resigned as CEO. Ramakarthikeyan has been appointed as senior advisor to the company.
